mr_title: fix(material/tabs): nav bar not navigating on enter presses
mr_description: Fixes that the tab nav bar wasn't navigating when pressing the enter key.

expected_issues.title: Enter activates routed tab links twice
expected_issues.description:
With a tabPanel, the new Enter branch calls nativeElement.click() without cancelling the key event. On an anchor with href whose click handler prevents native navigation (as a routed link can), focus stays on the anchor and the browser then performs its own Enter activation. One key press therefore invokes click handlers twice, causing duplicate application actions or routing requests.

A Chromium probe using the exact base/head handlers produced one click for the base and two for the head. Without href the counts are zero and one, confirming why explicit activation is needed for that case; disabled links produce zero in both versions. Preserve activation for non-native links while avoiding an extra synthetic click on natively activating anchors. The pre-existing Space behavior remains a known false positive. Generate the browser fixture with reproduce.py --browser-fixture and use real keyboard input; synthetic key-event dispatch does not exercise the browser default action.

known_false_positives.description: Space activation without preventDefault() is already present in base_sha for enabled links with a tabPanel. The diff adds Enter handling; it does not remove Space prevention. The later upstream fix was incorrectly associated with this introducing snapshot. Executing both handlers in corpora/curated/audit/reproduce.py confirms identical Space behavior.
